decision.reason: All 12 retained native supplied-Hamiltonian DF solves pass dense/oracle gates, complete auxiliary counts, admission checks and unfiltered small-solve memcheck. No complete native molecular DF CCSD(T) endpoint is claimed.

reproduction.instructions: Apply gzip -dc source.patch.gz | git apply to the exact parent. Set PYTHONPATH=python:., CUDA12.9.86 on PATH and checkout-root CCACHE_BASEDIR; use ccache for the separate objects. Run CUDA tests only with GENERATIVEQC_DF_CC_CUDA_TEST=1 inside finite Slurm main gpu:5090:1 allocation, preserving CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. qualification.json.gz contains exact record-generation source and complete test logs; point its final host/GPU binary paths to the pytest outputs. sanitizer.json.gz includes complete unfiltered logs and base64-encoded binary stdin. The probe input header is seven uint64 values followed by FP64 arrays as documented in tests; no reference library is imported by a native solver. Molecular exact-pair factorizations are solver oracles, not DF fitting accuracy claims. Hundreds-AO experiments are excluded from this acceptance.
